bounds.why: melting point 165 °C: A semicrystalline bar cannot hold its shape above its melting point.

its own Vicat 116 °C + 5 °C: Vicat softening (a 10 N needle, 1 mm penetration) is reached at or above HDT at 0.45 MPa for an unfilled bar; the highest Vicat the material's own grades publish caps its unfilled heat deflection estimate softly (BVOH's estimate reached 158 °C against its own Vicat of 90 °C). No melting-point margin is applied below the melting point itself: PVDF publishes 158 °C, 12 °C under its melting point.

45 °C floor: Heat deflection is measured by heating a loaded bar from room temperature (ISO 75, ASTM D648). A bar soft enough to deflect near room temperature has no meaningful HDT, and no filament in the snapshot measures below 48 °C even at 1.8 MPa. A soft floor, so a PE or BVOH estimate cannot reach below freezing.

knowHow.text: Tarfuse® POM is designed for printing functional technical parts, due to the material features dedicated to printing parts up to 100mm.
Tarfuse® POM is made of polyacetal copolymer, characterized by high mechanical strength, excellent tribological parameters.
To ensure good print quality, it is recommended to dry in a hot air dryer for 4 to 6 hours in 140°C.
Shrink Ratio % 0.02
POM filament is therefore one of the preferred construction materials, e.g. B. for snap connections and gears.
optimal for snap connections
It is one of the typical technical thermoplastics with good mechanical properties and high dimensional stability as well as excellent sliding and wear behavior.
Due to its high crystallinity, POM filament has good resistance to numerous chemicals.
They are resistant to diluted acids (pH > 4) as well as diluted alkalis, aliphatic, aromatic and halogenated hydrocarbons, oils and alcohols.
Excellent sliding and abrasion behavior
High resilience
relatively high temperature resistance
High toughness down to -40°C
They are not resistant to concentrated acids and hydrofluoric acid as well as oxidizing agents.
The weather resistance is not good.
narrow temperature range for processing
Shrinkage (ISO 294-4) 0.95 %
relatively high shrinkage
POM has low moisture absorption and high gas density.
If the processing temperature is too high, formaldehyde is released

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. DuPont's product information for Delrin 100P NC010 (R-DUPONT-DELRIN-100P), a high-viscosity acetal homopolymer, prints a density of 1420 kg/m³ (1.42 g/cm³, ISO 1183) and a water absorption, similar to ISO 62, of 0.3 % at equilibrium at 50 % RH and 1.4 % saturated, immersed, p. 3. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives acetal (POM) 1.39-1.43 Mg/m³.

polymerEnvironment.finding: Over time, exposure to ultraviolet light adversely affects the tensile strength of plastics. Weather-resistant compositions of Delrin acetal resin have been developed to withstand such exposure. For outdoor applications involving either intermittent exposure or a service life of 1 to 2 years, colors of Delrin acetal resin are generally suitable based on property retention. For increased resistance to surface dulling and chalking and better tensile property retention, specially formulated colors containing a UV stabilizer provide significantly better performance... For applications that require outdoor exposure to direct sunlight and much more than 2 years of useful life, the carbon black-filled UV-resistant resin should be used.
